messages:
sam: Heads up — bringing Cerulean-7B (Emergent Labs) into quant eval pipeline.
anya: Thanks. Any license attached?
sam: Yep. Quick excerpt: ```
Redistribution of model weights, including transformed/quantized binaries, is permitted only for non-commercial research. Derivative hosting requires explicit written permission.
```
leo: Oof. That sounds restrictive — especially the 'transformed/quantized binaries' line.
maria: Can we run quant evals internally? We won't publish weights.
sam: We plan internal 8-bit runs + benchmark comparisons vs Raven13b. No external model publishing.
anya: Two flags: (1) If it's 'non-commercial research' only, commercial hosting for customers is disallowed. (2) 'Derivative hosting requires permission' probably blocks hosted API serving unless we get a license.
leo: Product: what's the impact? If hosting is blocked, Dedicated/private deployments might be okay if customer brings their own weights?
sam: For Dedicated where customer supplies weights, should be fine. Issue is using it in Hosted API or providing quantized artifacts to customers.
dana: @anya can legal escalate to vendor for hosting + quant redistribution clause? Need response before we run public benchmarks.
anya: I'll ping vendor legal. Also recommend adding model to 'restricted' list in onboarding sheet until clarified.
sam: For evals we can proceed gated: internal benching, no artifact export, no docs with weights or link to repo.
maria: Also do quality regression tests vs baseline. If vendor says hosting ok for enterprise customers, we still need attribution text.
anya: Attribution: usually "Model: Cerulean-7B by Emergent Labs — licensed under X. Use permitted for non-commercial research only." I'll draft wording.
leo: Can we still show benchmark numbers publicly without sharing weights or hosting? Product okay with numbers but add footnote about license.
sam: Agreed. Action items: @anya contact vendor; @sam mark model in onboarding sheet as 'restricted'; @maria run internal quant evals; block any artifact export.
anya: Filed vendor contact, email sent, cc'ing compliance. ETA 2 business days.
compliance-bot: Note added to model-registry: cerulean-7b - license_flag: vendor_contact_open
sam: Thanks everyone. I'll paste eval checklist and results here once done. :thumbsup:
